title: Prophecies of Nostradamus
director: Toshio Masuda, Shûe Matsubayashi, Shirô Moritani
writer: Michel de Nostredame, Ben Gotô, Toshio Yasumi
actors: Tetsurô Tanba, Toshio Kurosawa, Kaoru Yumi
plot: A scientist fears that the prophecies of Nostradamus, including the end of all life on Earth, are coming true one after another.
